description: This file defines structures and functions related to calculating Transport Block Size (TBS) for 3GPP NR (New Radio) shared channels (PDSCH and PUSCH). It includes configuration parameters, conversion functions, and TBS calculation functions, following 3GPP TS38.214 specifications.

classes.name: tbs_calculator_configuration
classes.description: Structure holding parameters required for TBS calculation, including OFDM symbols, REs, modulation, layers, scaling, and resource allocation.

methods.name: tbs_calculator_pdsch_get_scaling_factor
methods.description: Converts TB scaling field into the scaling factor S as per TS38.214 Table 5.1.3.2-2.

methods.name: tbs_calculator_table_find_smallest_not_less_than
methods.description: Finds the smallest TBS in bits from TS38.214 Table 5.1.3.2-1 that is greater than or equal to a given value.

methods.name: tbs_calculator_calculate
methods.description: Calculates the transport block size (TBS) in bits for a given configuration, following TS38.214 Section 5.1.3.2.
